description: This file defines a set of simple service methods related to sales opportunities and sales forecasts in an Apache OFBiz project, including creating and updating sales forecasts and opportunities, as well as managing roles in sales opportunities.

methods.name: createSalesForecast
methods.description: Creates a sales forecast, stores it, and saves a copy in history.

methods.name: updateSalesForecast
methods.description: Updates a sales forecast and saves a copy in history.

methods.name: saveSalesForecastHistory
methods.description: Stores the sales forecast data in history with change notes.

methods.name: updateSalesOpportunity
methods.description: Updates an sales opportunity, sets estimated close date if needed.

methods.name: createSalesOpportunityAccountRole
methods.description: Creates an account role for a sales opportunity, ensuring party role.

methods.name: createSalesOpportunityLeadRole
methods.description: Creates a lead role for a sales opportunity, ensuring party role.

methods.name: findPartyInSalesOpportunityRole
methods.description: Finds party ID associated with a specific role in a sales opportunity.
